summary_md: **BlinkDL ([@BlinkDL_AI](https://x.com/BlinkDL_AI/status/2116562107529630104))** releases **RWKV-7 G1L**, a pure-RNN model update, with a demo, weights and a directory of 46 agentic RWKV projects ([rwkv7-g1 weights](https://huggingface.co/BlinkDL/rwkv7-g1), [agent project directory](https://agent.objects.rwkvos.com/en), [rwkv.com](https://www.rwkv.com/)).
relevance: Efficient RNN model family for local agents.

media.description: Uncheatable-eval leaderboard tables comparing RWKV-7 G1L with Qwen, Gemma, Mistral and other base models by compression score across code, arXiv, news and Wikipedia, with a note that Qwen 3.5 still leads on code and arXiv.
